verdict.rationale: The skills ship as separate folders, each with its own `SKILL.md`, and the docs describe using any single skill on its own (paste one `SKILL.md` into a chat) or copying folders into `.claude/skills/`. That gives a documented, if manual, way to take individual skills. However, the primary plugin install path installs the whole `replica-skill` bundle, and the skills are designed to run in order, each reading the previous one's output, which limits standalone use. Missing for 10: an explicit per-skill install command or selection in the plugin/marketplace flow, documentation of which skills work independently of earlier ones, and hands-on corroboration of selective installation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle

citations.quote: Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
